label: Driving State
description: State of action or repose, with environmental effects and occupant status.

items.name: auto-show-pose
items.text: The car is unoccupied and perfectly stationary in a pristine auto-show pose, wheels dead straight, weight settled evenly on all four contact patches so the body sits level and every panel gap reads clean.

items.name: magazine-parked
items.text: The car is unoccupied and elegantly parked with the front wheels turned to present the rim face and caliper to the camera, cover-shoot style, the turned wheel opening the arch to the light.

items.name: poised-motionless
items.text: The car is unoccupied, poised and motionless, brake discs cold and suspension settled, holding the coiled potential of a machine one ignition press from launch.

items.name: cruising-smooth
items.text: The car is cruising at moderate speed, a driver's silhouette faint behind tinted glass; the background and wheel rims carry smooth motion blur while the bodywork stays tack sharp.

items.name: gliding-curve
items.text: The car is gliding through a gentle open-road curve, the body leaning a single graceful degree onto its loaded outside springs, a partially obscured driver focused on the road ahead.

items.name: low-tracking-float
items.text: The car is caught by a low tracking shot at speed, appearing to float over the pavement, wheels blurred into discs while every badge and shutline on the body stays crisp; the driver a subtle presence in the cockpit.

items.name: powerslide-drift
items.text: The car is executing a controlled powerslide around a paved corner at full opposite lock, thick plumes of tire smoke boiling off the rear arches, the helmeted driver clearly visible working the wheel.

items.name: launch-standstill
items.text: The car is launching from a standstill, rear suspension squatting hard, rear tire sidewalls wrinkling under torque while the nose goes light; a helmeted driver grips the steering wheel.

items.name: hard-braking
items.text: The car is braking hard into a corner, nose diving over compressed front springs, brake discs glowing orange through the spokes, the helmeted driver braced against the deceleration.

items.name: cornering-limit
items.text: The car is cornering at the limit, weight loaded onto the outside tires with their sidewalls visibly deformed against the rim edge, a few degrees of body roll telling the truth about grip; the helmeted driver actively steering through.

items.name: concours-flawless
items.text: The unoccupied car stands in flawless concours condition, paint detailed to a depth that holds undistorted reflections, untouched by road or weather (this is the default state).

items.name: road-grime
items.text: The recently parked, unoccupied car wears the honest evidence of a finished drive: fine road grime misted across the front fascia and rocker panels, brake discs ticking as they cool.

items.name: rain-beaded
items.text: The unoccupied car is uniformly wet from a passing shower, water beaded tight on the waxed paint with each droplet acting as a tiny lens, the ground beneath dark and damp.

items.name: fresh-tire-marks
items.text: The car has just come to a stop, fresh black tire marks curving across the pavement behind it, faint smoke still rising off the warm rear tires, the helmeted driver still seated.

items.name: pit-stop
items.text: The car sits in a high-tech pit box captured mid-tire-change, wheel guns flashing, the pit crew motion-blurred around a body held razor sharp.

items.name: dynamometer-run
items.text: The car is strapped to a dynamometer inside a workshop, rear wheels spun to a complete blur on the rollers, tie-down straps pulled taut, a technician or helmeted driver operating from the seat.

items.name: detailing
items.text: The unoccupied car is under meticulous detailing in a bright pristine workshop, a detailer feathering a polisher across one panel, swirl-free paint blazing under the inspection lamps.
